llm_c1_event_xs.hypothesis: typed asset-linked event features from PIT news carry XS predictive content for 1-10d forward returns beyond price/volume/funding

extractor.two_stage: headline+summary first; full content only on ambiguous=true (1 retry)

llm_c1_event_xs.corpus: alpaca store (orig + C2 backfill + 797-sym wide backfill 2021-01..2025-03) + gdelt store (2021-01..2025-03); frozen before P0 sampling; fetch failures disclosed in manifest

holdout: 2026-07-01 — SEALED, one-shot only if P3 passes; virgin for event-feature family (predlab book claims are a separate family, disclosed)

probes.P0_extraction_quality: 300 stratified (200 prefilter-pos, 100 prefilter-neg); hybrid ground truth: claude-haiku-4-5 pre-label + blind human adjudication of all disagreements + 60-article agreement subsample; gates precision>=0.8, recall>=0.6, asset-link>=0.9, prefilter recall>=0.85, anon agreement>=0.8; ONE amendment round (fresh 100-article audit) then STOP
probes.P1_breadth: >=60 mapped symbols with >=1 dev-window event; >=8 events/month avg (all classes) in 2023+; STOP if unmet
probes.P2_event_study: per-class CAR(1-10d, t+1 open) vs vol-rank-matched controls, block bootstrap; signs: hack-, delist-, regulatory-, insolvency-, listing+, unlock-, upgrade+; PASS needs >=2 classes p<0.05 with registered sign
probes.P3_portfolio: incremental to vol-rank+momentum+size baseline in §43 XS harness, 799-sym store, 5bp+funding: net SR improvement >= +0.15, dual-family placebo p<0.05, DSR>0.5 at declared n, 3/4 sub-periods non-negative; standalone reported, cannot pass

llm_c1_event_xs.multiplicity: <=12 ledgered configs (P0 2, P2 7, P3 <=3); ledger data/llm_event_xs/trial_ledger.jsonl append-only
llm_c1_event_xs.stop_rule: any probe STOP = charter dead this cycle; no post-hoc class exclusions; no prompt changes after P0 pass; no re-sampling after audit results exist; holdout untouched until registered one-shot; extraction store retained regardless of verdict
